summary.en: Taliban forces opened fire on Pakistani security forces along the Kurram border, killing a Pakistani officer and several militants in Balochistan. Pakistan suspended trade at two Iran border crossings amid violence and smuggling concerns, while a dispute over the Zangali checkpost is disrupting operations at the Torkham crossing, adding to broader trade tolls with Iran and Afghanistan. Pakistan is moving to ratify a defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey that expands security cooperation beyond bilateral frameworks. The United Nations warns of a famine risk in Afghanistan, and transnational militancy remains active along the Iran-Pakistan border. 1,794 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Taliban-styrker skjøt mot pakistanske sikkerhetsstyrker langs Kurram-grensen, og drepte en pakistansk offiser og flere militante i Balochistan. Pakistan stanset handelen ved to grenseoverganger til Iran på grunn av vold og bekymringer om smugling, mens en tvist om Zangali-kontrollposten forstyrrer driften ved Torkham-overgangen, noe som øker de bredere handelsutfordringene med Iran og Afghanistan. Pakistan arbeider med å ratifisere en forsvarspakt med Saudi-Arabia og Tyrkia som utvider sikkerhetssamarbeidet utover bilaterale rammer. FN advarer om sultfare i Afghanistan, og transnasjonal militans er fortsatt aktiv langs Iran-Pakistan-grensen. 1 794 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
